content:
maria: Heads-up — ACME private rollout readiness call tomorrow 10am PT. We still have 3 networking blockers: NAT session limit, SNI passthrough for registries, and offline image sync issues.
jon: can you list owners for each?
maria: NAT -> @sam, SNI -> @alex, image sync -> @priya. Also we need a CR for firewall rules and a customer-signed SoW.
sam: taking NAT. I checked their edge NAT — only 512 concurrent sessions allowed. For our traffic patterns we need ~2k. Options: increase NAT conn limit or implement source IP pooling. I can prototype a scaling rule but need netops approval.
alex: SNI passthrough blocked by our egress-proxy not forwarding TLS SNI for registry hostnames. PR up: https://git.internal/r/234 (small change to passthrough logic). Need someone to CR.
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: canaries scheduled 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC.
priya: image sync failing on checksum mismatch when pulling across airgap. Ticket #7123 created with logs. Likely the registry signs blobs differently when mirrored; proposing an offline tarball + verify flow.
maria: target milestone: canary by Friday EOD if NAT + SNI fixed. If not, fallback plan is deploy with reduced capacity and route non-critical traffic to hosted.
jon: quick ask for devex — can we standardize a CR template for airgapped customers? saves time during handoffs. @maria you okay to draft?
maria: yes — draft below, please comment.
```
CR checklist:
- FW: allow outbound 443 to registry.corp and package mirrors
- DNS: resolver 10.0.0.2 + host entries for internal registry
- Image sync: run `rwd-sync --manifest manifest.json --offline` on bastion
- Cert rotation window: provide 2hr maintenance window for tunnel cert swap
- Rollback: keep previous model image available and traffic split 10/90 during canary
```
sam: CR drafted and added to the ticket, requesting netops sanity-check on NAT conn limit and expected throughput. @netops can you review topology and conn numbers?
netops: on it. Asked ACME for topology diagram and current NAT appliance model. If it's an HA pair we can push conn limits but need config window.
maria: uploaded topology PDF to the ticket (link in thread). @alex can you add code-review for the egress-proxy PR? it's a tiny change to TLS passthrough and adds a config toggle.
alex: will review today, aiming to merge by 4pm PT. If merged, I can cut a canary build and push to staging for a quick smoke.
priya: one more from customer — what's our rollback plan if the canary errors due to image mismatch? propose we keep previous image available and circuit-break traffic to hosted model if errors > 5% for 10m.
maria: agreed, I'll add that to the runbook and the CR. Thanks all for quick turn — please ping here if you need help coordinating CR windows or have vendor tickets to escalate. :thumbsup:
